description: Measurement Protocol requests to the Google Analytics 4 collection endpoint, including the regional and debug variants and the JSON event payload.

params.name: api_secret
params.description: It authenticates the request and is created in the GA4 admin UI.
params.fix_hint: Create a Measurement Protocol API secret for the stream and send it as `api_secret`.

params.name: measurement_id
params.description: Web stream measurement IDs start with `G-`.
params.fix_hint: Use the web stream measurement ID, or send `firebase_app_id` for an app stream.

params.name: firebase_app_id
params.description: It identifies an app stream and replaces `measurement_id`.

rules.message: The request identifies no GA4 stream. Web streams send `measurement_id` and app streams send `firebase_app_id`.
rules.fix_hint: Add `measurement_id` for a web stream or `firebase_app_id` for an app stream.

rules.message: The request sends both `measurement_id` and `firebase_app_id`. One request targets one stream type.
rules.fix_hint: Keep the identifier that matches the stream this event belongs to and drop the other.

params.name: client_id
params.description: It identifies the browser or device the event belongs to, and events without it are not joined to a user.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_ga` cookie's client id, or a stable id of your own.

params.name: events
params.description: Google documents the events array as the one required field of the request body. An empty array sends no events at all.
params.fix_hint: Send an `events` array holding at least one event.

params.name: timestamp_micros
params.description: Google documents this as a Unix timestamp in microseconds, not milliseconds. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and a 10-digit value is seconds.
params.fix_hint: Multiply a millisecond timestamp by 1000, or a second timestamp by 1000000.

params.name: non_personalized_ads
params.description: Google marks it deprecated in the Measurement Protocol reference.

params.name: name
params.description: Google documents event names as 40 characters or fewer.
params.fix_hint: Use a short name of letters, digits, and underscores, starting with a letter.

params.name: params.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code, and Google requires it whenever `value` is set.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: params.value
params.description: It is the monetary value of the event.
params.fix_hint: Set it to the sum of price times quantity across the items, excluding shipping and tax.

params.name: params.transaction_id
params.description: It identifies the transaction, and Google requires it for purchase and refund events.

params.name: params.items
params.description: It lists the items the event covers.

rules.message: The event carries a `value` with no `currency`. Google documents currency as required whenever value is set, and drops the revenue otherwise.
rules.fix_hint: Add `currency` as an ISO 4217 code alongside the value.

rules.message: A `purchase` event is missing fields Google documents as required for it, so it will not report revenue correctly.
rules.fix_hint: Add the required ecommerce parameters to the event.

rules.message: A `refund` event is missing fields Google documents as required for it, so it will not report revenue correctly.
rules.fix_hint: Add the required ecommerce parameters to the event.

rules.message: Google documents `currency`, `value`, and `items` as required for this ecommerce event.
rules.fix_hint: Add `currency`, `value`, and the `items` array to the event.
